consent.title: PickUpNews uses essential local storage
consent.description: We store feeds, saved articles, language, theme, and app preferences in your browser so the app works correctly.

legal.privacyIntro: PickUpNews stores feeds, saved articles, theme, and preferences in your browser localStorage so the app works between sessions.
legal.privacyDataBody: The app stores feed list, saved articles, language, theme, notification preferences, and technical app preferences in local browser storage.
legal.privacyPurposeBody: Stored data is used only to provide core app functionality and preserve your preferences between sessions.
legal.privacyRetentionBody: You can clear local data from browser storage at any time.
legal.cookiesIntro: PickUpNews uses browser storage technologies for essential app features.
legal.cookiesEssentialBody: Used for feeds list, saved items, language, theme, and app preferences required to provide the service.
legal.cookiesAnalyticsBody: No non-essential analytics storage is currently active in the app.
legal.cookiesHowToManageBody: Use the consent banner choices or clear site data in your browser settings to remove stored data.
legal.clearStoredDataConfirm: This will remove all PickUpNews data saved in your browser and reload the app. Continue?
